change: A shorter Bestiary: the foes still in the dark stand small side by side over one counted line, and a realm's tests are said once

mutations.name: the shadows count in figures
mutations.find: return `Not yet beaten: ${WORD[n]||n} foes wait in ${nm}${boss?', the boss among them':''}.`;
mutations.replace: return `Not yet beaten: ${n} foes wait in ${nm}${boss?', the boss among them':''}.`;

mutations.name: the boss is not named among them
mutations.find: return `Not yet beaten: ${WORD[n]||n} foes wait in ${nm}${boss?', the boss among them':''}.`;
mutations.replace: return `Not yet beaten: ${WORD[n]||n} foes wait in ${nm}.`;

mutations.name: a lone boss reads as any foe
mutations.find: if(n===1) return boss ? `Not yet beaten: the boss of ${nm}.` : `Not yet beaten: one foe waits in ${nm}.`;
mutations.replace: if(n===1) return `Not yet beaten: one foe waits in ${nm}.`;

mutations.name: an empty realm still gets a line
the line counts every foe, not those in the dark
a realm's tests go unsaid, seen in play
the shadows stack again, seen in play
the line counts every foe, seen in play
